स्नुह्,
स्नुहा, -हिः f., 
-ही The milk-hedge plant. [Raghunandana, the author of Kṛtyatattva (Jīvānanda's ed. of Smṛtitattva vol. II, 1895) quotes a verse from the Devīpurāṇa in connection with the worship of the goddess Manasā to get rid of the fear of snake-bite (cf. Dr. Kane's History of Dharma-śāstra, vol. [[V.]] p. 125). He explains स्नुही as सिजुवृक्षः. The botanic name of the tree is Euphorbia Nerifolia (Mar. निवहुंग). It is a plant from the stem of which a sticky substance oozes out.]
